title: Staff Software Engineer (Bangalore, India)
description:
About AiPrise

AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer in Bangalore to set the technical direction for the core platform behind AiPrise's compliance orchestration and AI agent systems.

This is our most senior individual-contributor role. You will own the architecture of a major part of the platform, lead the hardest multi-quarter technical initiatives across teams, and raise the engineering bar for a team that is growing fast. You'll work directly with the head of engineering, engineering managers, product managers, FDEs, etc. to turn customer and regulatory needs into technical strategy, and then ship it.

We process verification requests for financial institutions in a regulated environment, so reliability, security, and data integrity are not afterthoughts. If you want a role where your judgment shapes how the platform scales for the next several years, and where you still write code, this is it.

What You'll Do

Set technical direction

- Own the architecture and multi-quarter technical roadmap for a core area of the platform: vendor orchestration, case management, platform, or the AI agents 
- Lead our largest and most ambiguous technical initiatives end to end: framing the problem, design, sequencing across teams, delivery, and rollout or migration 
- Author and review RFCs, run design reviews, and make the hard calls on build vs. buy, consistency vs. speed, and when to pay down debt 
- Set the standard for reliability, security, and data integrity in a regulated environment: SLOs, incident response, change management, and audit-readiness 

Scale the platform

- Evolve the orchestration layer to handle 10x verification volume across 80+ vendors: throughput, latency, failover, and cost 
- Shape the developer platform (service boundaries, shared libraries, CI/CD, observability) so a fast-growing team can ship safely and often 
- Take our AI agent systems from promising to production-grade: evaluation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop workflows, and the data pipelines behind them 
- Stay hands-on: prototype the risky parts, unblock critical paths, and ship code that others build on 

Multiply the team

- Act as technical lead and mentor to senior engineers; grow the next generation of tech leads 
- Partner with the founders, engineering managers, product, and compliance experts on the roadmap; translate customer and regulatory needs into technical strategy 
- Represent engineering with enterprise customers on architecture, security reviews, and integration design 
- Help us hire: design interviews, calibrate the bar, and close senior candidates 

What We're Looking For

Must-have

- 9+ years building and operating production systems, with at least 2 years at Staff-level scope: setting technical direction for multiple teams or a major system 
- A track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives from an ambiguous problem to a shipped, adopted result 
- Deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture: service design, data modeling, API design, event-driven systems, consistency trade-offs, and failure modes 
- You have designed, scaled, and operated high-throughput, high-reliability systems, and carried the pager for them 
- Strong in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable working across the stack when the problem calls for it 
- Writing that changes decisions: RFCs, design docs, and postmortems that a team can act on 
- Experience mentoring senior engineers and measurably raising an organization's engineering standards 
- Judgment about when to be pragmatic and when to insist, and the credibility to carry either call with founders and peers 

Nice-to-have

- Experience in FinTech, RegTech, payments, identity verification, or fraud/risk detection, and working knowledge of KYC/KYB, AML, and sanctions screening 
- Built or operated a platform that integrates dozens of third-party vendors: response normalization, failover, rate limits, and vendor observability 
- Shipped production LLM or ML systems: evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, document intelligence 
- Security and compliance engineering: SOC 2 or ISO 27001, data residency, encryption, audit trails 
- Helped an engineering team grow several-fold while keeping quality and velocity up 
- Frontend experience (React, TypeScript) for internal tools and case management UI 

Success in This Role Looks Like

- In 1 month: You understand the platform end to end, have shipped a meaningful improvement to a critical path, and have published an RFC with a clear point of view on our highest-leverage technical problem. You've taken on technical leadership of a core area. 
- In 3 months: You're leading a cross-team initiative with a defined roadmap and visible progress. Design reviews and RFCs are a working habit across the team, not a ritual. At least one reliability or velocity metric has moved because of your work. 
- In 3 months: The architecture for the platform's next phase is defined and delivered. Senior engineers you've mentored are leading their own initiatives. The founders and engineering managers treat you as the technical counterpart for the hardest calls. 

Why AiPrise

- Direct impact: Your decisions shape infrastructure that processes millions of verifications and fights financial crime for leading financial institutions 
- Hard problems: Compliance, AI, fraud detection, and distributed systems, across data from 200+ countries and 80+ vendors 
- Real ownership: Set technical direction for the platform at the stage where it matters most 
- Fast loop: Your code reaches production in days, not months 
- The team: Work in person with a mission-driven team in Bangalore, alongside the founders 
- Compensation: Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits 

About The Interview

- Remote: Exploratory DSA Round 
- In-office 
- Remote: Behavioural (Head of Engineering) 
- Remote: Compensation Discussion

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the Role:

A Senior SDE at Razorpay is well-grounded - smart, quality-focused, product-thinking, and business-conscious. Not a mere coder. You bring strong technical context and the experience to build software that matters at scale. Engineering at Razorpay creates significant impact across the payments ecosystem. You are expected to influence the culture of the company - bring conviction, challenge the status quo, set the bar, and help the team grow. We are looking for engineers who are current - not just technically strong, but actively working in AI-augmented workflows. At Razorpay, AI is not a feature we are building toward - it is part of how we build today.

What You Will Build

- Scale Razorpay's payment infrastructure to get every Indian to pay online

- Shape REST APIs used by developers worldwide

- Contribute to open source and set standards for mobile payments

- Drive product and design discussions - not just implement them

- Brainstorm and create new directions in Razorpay's quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all

What We Are Looking For

- 3+ years of experience in technology

- Strong product design sense - you think about the user, not just the implementation

- Proficiency in any of: PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, or C++

- Ability to understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases, and arrive at effective solutions

- Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general

- Ability to build a feature from scratch and drive it to completion independently

- Willingness to learn new technology - whatever lets you deliver the best product

- Clean, well-structured code as a default - with awareness of performance and time complexity trade-offs

AI fluency we expect:

- Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants - you use them actively, not occasionally

- Ability to decompose problems into structured, constrained prompts with clear expected outcomes

- Critical review mindset - you own every line of AI-generated code, spot hallucinations, incorrect assumptions, and security gaps

- Strong LLD depth before agent use - you design first, delegate second

- Awareness of where AI helps and where it fails - and the judgment to know the difference

Why This Role Is Different 

- Most companies say they want engineers who care about product. We actually mean it. You will influence product direction from day one - not just implement specs.

- No whiteboard coding. No obscure algorithm puzzles. Every round mirrors what you would actually do at Razorpay. If you have been doing the same thing for two years and want a reset - this role will challenge you in ways that are hard to find elsewhere.

Good to Have

- Weekend side projects or contributions to open source on GitHub

- Prior experience at a product company

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agentic frameworks

- Working knowledge of a backend programming language beyond your primary stack

- Experience designing systems for scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance

title: Senior System Software Engineer - GPU
description:
NVIDIA is seeking an outstanding Senior System Software Engineer to join our Display Driver team. You will develop production-quality system software for next-generation NVIDIA GPU and Tegra platforms, working across operating systems such as Linux and Android.
The role combines broad kernel-mode driver development with opportunities to work on display security technologies, including High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP). You will collaborate with hardware, firmware, security, and system software teams to deliver reliable and secure display solutions.

What you’ll be doing
- Design, develop, test, and maintain GPU/display kernel-mode drivers and embedded firmware.
- Develop system software across Linux, Android or similar operating system.
- Implement and maintain HDCP and related display-content-protection functionality.
- Debug interactions across software, firmware, hardware, and external display devices.
- Develop multithreaded, performance-sensitive software in C.
- Participate in design, code, and security reviews.
- Build automated tests and diagnostic tools to improve reliability and interoperability.
- Collaborate with teams across NVIDIA and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

What we need to see
- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of experience developing system software, embedded software, firmware, or kernel-mode drivers.
- Strong C programming and debugging skills.
- Solid understanding of operating-system fundamentals, computer architecture, memory management, synchronization, and concurrency.
- Experience developing low-level software on Linux, Android, or a similar operating system.
- Familiarity with secure protocols, cryptographic concepts, authentication, key management, or content-protection technologies.

- Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
- Experience implementing or debugging HDCP 1.x/2.x authentication and content-protection flows.
- Knowledge of HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode, DDC/I²C, or DisplayPort AUX protocols.
- Experience with Linux DRM/KMS or graphics/display kernel drivers.
- Familiarity with trusted execution environments, secure firmware, hardware security modules, or secure key provisioning.
- Experience in debugging display interoperability, or content-protection certification issues.

Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. Serve as a hands-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle.
Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks.
Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions.

About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.

Job Summary

NCR VOYIX Corporation is seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer (I) to join our innovative team. This entry-level position will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of cutting-edge software solutions within a collaborative and dynamic environment.

Job Responsibilities
• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
• Use AI to Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code in accordance with established coding standards and best practices.
• Collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and contribute to technical discussions.
• Assist in troubleshooting and resolving software defects and issues.
• Develop and execute unit tests and participate in integration and system testing.
• Learn and apply new technologies, tools, and methodologies relevant to project needs.
• Contribute to code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
• Maintain and improve existing software applications.
• Document technical designs, processes, and procedures.

Job Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Solid understanding of fundamental computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
• Proficiency in programming language (e.g., Go, TypeScript, React ).
• Cloud experience (GCP, Azure, AWS). GCP a plus. Exposure to deployment processes and CI/CD practices is an added advantage, with hands-on experience in **Docker and Kubernetes** preferred.
• Familiarity with software development tools and methodologies (e.g., version control systems like GitHub, Git Actions, Agile development).
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
• Prior internship or project experience in software development is a plus.
• 3-6 years of experience in the role or a related field.

This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake additional duties and projects that are consistent with their skills, capabilities, and the overall purpose of the position

description:

title: Specialist, Software Engineering
location: IND - Telangana - Hyderabad (Hitec City Raidurg), India
description:
Job Description

The Opportunity:

- Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
- 
- Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
- Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.
 
Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
 
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
 
Role Overview:
 
As a Software Engineer specializing in Kinaxis Maestro, your main job is to configure and implement the software to meet specific business needs. This means turning business requirements into clear software specifications while ensuring high quality and timely delivery. You will be key in customizing Kinaxis Maestro to improve supply chain management processes, using your technical skills and working closely with various stakeholders.
 
What will you do in this role:
 
- Design, configure and implement Kinaxis Maestro based on business requirements, translating needs into detailed software specifications that meet user stories and deadlines.
- Join supply chain planning design sessions focused on demand/supply planning and order scheduling to shape solution requirements.
- Lead data integration and transformation efforts, manage QA/UAT, and collect user feedback to improve implementations.
- Coordinate with Kinaxis product engineering, professional services, and support to drive product enhancements.
- Run deployment workshops and train/support end users during testing to ensure smooth adoption.
 
Primary skills (must-have)

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or Supply Chain Management.
- 5 years of authoring experience in Kinaxis Maestro (formerly RapidResponse).
- Experience in software implementations or deployments within supply chain planning modules, including Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Inventory Management, and Production Planning and Scheduling.
- Proven experience applying supply chain concepts to forecasting, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Constraint Management, and Production Scheduling.
- Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with a focus on using these languages for data integration and orchestration to optimize workflows and enhance data processing efficiency.
- Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and release management techniques.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Solid understanding of data modeling and data architecture principles.
 
Primary skills (must-have)
 
Kinaxis Maestro/RapidResponse authoring
 
Secondary skills (nice to have)
 
supply chain planning modules, MRP, constraints, forecasting, or scheduling.
 
Who we are:
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
 
What we look for:
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Senior Software Developer - ServiceNow
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Position Summary:

At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care. 
The ServiceNow Senior Developer is responsible for the design, development, and implementation of complex ServiceNow solutions. This includes working with business stakeholders to understand their needs and to develop solutions that meet those needs. The ServiceNow Developer will also be responsible for maintaining and enhancing existing ServiceNow applications, as well as troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise.
If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
Key Responsibilities
- Design, architect, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow solutions.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and develop solutions that address their business needs.
- Maintain and enhance existing ServiceNow applications.
- Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow-related issues.
- Stay up to date with the latest ServiceNow features and functionality.
- Mentor and train junior ServiceNow developers to enhance their technical skills.
- Contribute to the development and implementation of ServiceNow development standards and best practices.
- Collaborate with business analysts to identify, analyze, and document business processes that can be automated using ServiceNow.
- Work with IT Operations engineers to integrate ServiceNow with other IT systems, such as monitoring and ticketing systems.
- Apply a user experience-focused approach when designing, developing, and deploying customer-centric solutions.
- Participate in Agile planning ceremonies to define and prioritize ServiceNow tasks for upcoming sprints.
- Develop and test ServiceNow solutions in accordance with Agile methodologies.
- Deploy and support ServiceNow solutions in production environments.
- Monitor ServiceNow performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal system functionality.
- Share knowledge and best practices with team members through code reviews, pair programming, and training sessions.
- Demonstrate self-direction and the ability to make sound decisions based on thorough data analysis and process evaluation.
- Lead the team by coordinating activities, providing technical guidance, and supporting team members to achieve project objectives.
Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- 6+ years of experience in ServiceNow development and implementation.
- ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or HR Service Delivery (HRSD) certification is a plus.
- Hands-on experience with the following ServiceNow modules is required:Service PortalHR Service Delivery (HRSD)ServiceNow WorkspacesVirtual Agent
Experience with the following ServiceNow modules is an added advantage:
- IT Service Management (ITSM)
- IT Operations Management (ITOM)
- IT Asset Management (ITAM)
- Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)
- Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
Additional Skills and Experience
- Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer and Service Catalog.
- Experience with Agile development methodologies.
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills.
- Experience with ServiceNow integrations.
- Experience with ServiceNow reporting and analytics.
- Experience with ServiceNow scripting languages.
- Experience with ServiceNow performance tuning and optimization.
- Experience with ServiceNow family release upgrades.
- Experience with ServiceNow Workspace development.
- Knowledge of the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM) framework is a plus.
- Experience with ServiceNow security and compliance is a plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full Stack
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Role Overview
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer) to design, build, and maintain scalable web applications across the front end, back end, and cloud infrastructure. This role requires a strong foundation in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, Python and Node.js backend development, containerized microservices, and hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features end-to-end — from UI implementation to API design to cloud deployment — and collaborates effectively within an Agile team.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain full stack web applications spanning front-end, back-end, and cloud environments
- Develop and integrate REST/SOAP APIs and microservices to support business applications and AI-driven workflows
- Enhance, troubleshoot, and support existing production applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability
- Deploy and manage applications on AWS using containerized (Docker/ECS Fargate) and serverless (Lambda/API Gateway) architectures
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers within an Agile development process
- Participate in code reviews and apply static code analysis and security scanning tools to maintain code quality
- Collaborate with IT partners, business teams, and the broader IT matrix organization to understand requirements and use cases, support solution design and delivery of new digital capabilities, and contribute to the enablement and simplification of existing ones — translating requirements into user stories, epics, and sprint-ready tasks using Agile/Scrum methodologies
- Gather requirements, propose solution options, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Desired Experience
Front End
- Strong hands-on experience building production applications with ReactJS (with TypeScript); working knowledge of Next.js
- Experience with React Native for mobile development
- Exposure to an additional front-end framework such as Vue.js is a plus
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
- Experience with modern CSS frameworks/libraries such as Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, and component libraries like shadcn/ui
Back End
- Solid experience with Python and Node.js for building server-side applications and services
- Experience designing and building REST APIs; familiarity with SOAP APIs
- Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and Docker containerization
- Experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, and Express.js
- Understanding of ORM concepts and implementation
Database
- Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB (or similar relational and NoSQL databases)
- Familiarity with SQLite for lightweight/local data storage use cases
- Practical experience with data modeling for both relational and NoSQL systems
Cloud (AWS)
- Hands-on experience with core AWS services: API Gateway, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, EC2, ECR, ECS Fargate, ALB, NLB, and IAM
- Understanding of serverless and containerized deployment patterns on AWS
- Working knowledge of AWS security and access management (IAM roles/policies)
DevOps
- Proficient with Git for version control and collaborative development workflows
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code using CloudFormation
- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, and CodeDeploy
- Familiarity with static code analysis and linting tools such as PyLint and ESLint
Tools & Collaboration
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot within VS Code
- Experience working with JIRA and Confluence in an Agile development environment
- Strong track record of participating in code reviews and applying static code analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk Code

Good to Have
- Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts and application development
- Experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph for building AI-driven workflows and agents
- Familiarity with Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock
- Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its use in AI tool integrations

Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About Apollo

Apollo is the AI-powered go-to-market platform that helps revenue teams find, engage, and convert their best customers. We combine a database of more than 210 million contacts and 35 million companies with an agentic end-to-end GTM platform, and more than 500,000 companies rely on us to run their go-to-market motion. We are profitable, growing fast, and rebuilding the product around AI and agents.

Your role and mission

You will set technical direction at the level of the whole engineering organization. You will own the hardest, most ambiguous, and highest-stakes technical bets, the ones that shape the product for years, and you will be a force multiplier across many teams. Your judgment will be a reference point for how we build, and your impact will be felt org-wide rather than on any single team.

What You Will Do

- Own the technical direction of Apollo's most critical and most ambiguous problems, across team and organizational boundaries
- Make the architectural bets that shape the product and platform over multiple years, and be accountable for how they play out
- Set the technical strategy for the rebuild around AI and agents, and turn it into direction teams can execute
- Raise the engineering bar across the whole organization through the standards, patterns, and decisions you drive
- Multiply the output of engineers and teams far beyond your own code, through design, review, and mentorship of our most senior engineers
- Partner with engineering and product leadership as a peer on where the technology needs to go. 

How we work: AI-native by default

You set the standard for what AI-native engineering looks like at the highest level. You use agents to move faster on the hardest design, investigation, and implementation work, you define the practices other engineers adopt, and you find the step-change bets where AI reshapes how we build the product, not just how fast we ship.

What We Are Looking For

- A track record of setting technical direction that shaped a product or platform across an entire engineering organization
- Depth across distributed systems and architecture, and command of the reliability, scale, and cost tradeoffs behind company-defining decisions
- The judgment to make the hardest calls under ambiguity, and the influence to align many teams behind them
- A record of multiplying the most senior engineers around you. Genuine, current fluency with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where AI takes engineering next

Our tech stack

React on the front end; Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Python, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch on the backend; Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform in infrastructure; GCP for cloud.

What You Will Love About Apollo

You will own the technical bets that define the company, work as a peer to engineering and product leadership, and have the scope and AI tooling to shape how a fast-moving organization builds.

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Conversational AI and Voice Applications)
description:
Company Description

Attain Solutions provides software development, implementation, quality assurance and support services for international clients. We are seeking a hands-on senior engineer to assess and deliver a voice-based practice capability for a US training business serving insurance agencies.

In the proposed experience, the AI plays a customer throughout a short conversation. The learner speaks naturally, while the customer raises a relevant concern, responds to questions and keeps its facts and character consistent. After the session, a separate assessment produces scores and a coaching PDF. The first scope is a personal-lines and commercial-lines pair, using client-approved content.

Job Description

What you will own

- Assess existing LMS capabilities, reusable prototypes and focused extensions before recommending a configured or custom solution. Document feasibility, dependencies, delivery effort and operating costs. 
- Build a working two-way voice prototype, including responsive audio, turn-taking, interruption handling, session state and recovery from common failures. 
- Implement the customer role with approved facts, a persona, objections and an objective. Support varied learner responses and natural endings without feeding the learner the expected answers. 
- Convert approved training material into configurable, versioned scenarios and rubrics. Keep the customer simulation separate from post-session assessment. 
- Investigate launch from Absorb LMS, browser microphone access and learner identity. Validate an embedded experience and a separate-tab fallback; implement the agreed access and completion approach. 

Engineering Responsibilities

- Produce evidence-based scores and balanced coaching. Apply approved weights, exclusions and serious-error rules; calculate totals in code and keep the PDF consistent with the underlying results. 
- Store learner, agency, scenario, rubric and attempt records. Generate branded PDFs and an agreed basic export; preserve structured data for later reporting integrations. 
- Implement agency and learner usage allowances, reset rules, alerts and limits as agreed. Handle simultaneous requests, retries and failed attempts without duplicate charging or results. 
- Protect agency data boundaries, credentials and recordings. Apply agreed access, retention and deletion rules, with useful logs that do not expose unnecessary personal data. 
- Deploy and maintain the application, manage environments and secrets, monitor latency and usage, resolve defects and hand over source code, configuration and operating documentation. 

Qualifications

Essential experience and skills

- Proven ownership of at least one working two-way voice application or conversational product with spoken interaction. Be ready to explain your contribution, architecture, latency, interruption handling, failure recovery and usage costs. 
- Strong frontend development with TypeScript and React or a comparable framework; browser audio capture and playback, asynchronous UI behaviour, microphone permissions and session error states. 
- Backend development in Python, for example FastAPI, or Node.js with TypeScript; REST APIs, WebSockets and/or WebRTC integration, authentication, background work and relational data modelling. 
- Practical integration of LLM and speech services, using either real-time speech-to-speech or speech recognition, a language model and speech synthesis. Strength in one coherent stack is sufficient. 
- Prompt and context design, structured model outputs, scenario grounding and evaluation. Ability to test responses against approved facts and recognise when the system should acknowledge missing information. 
- Third-party API integration, secure session handling, SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, PDF generation and reliable export workflows. 
- Automated testing and debugging across the browser, backend and AI services; Git, code review, deployment pipelines, Docker or equivalent packaging, and one cloud environment. 
- Clear written English and the ability to translate a business requirement into a small, testable release, explaining assumptions and trade-offs to a non-technical project lead. 

Preferred Experience

Absorb or another LMS; LTI 1.3, OIDC/SSO or secure external-tool launches; multi-tenant SaaS; rubric-based AI evaluation; training/coaching products; insurance workflows; document retrieval; and integrations with Sheets, BigQuery, HubSpot or Zapier. Avatar integration is useful if later included in scope. These are advantages, not requirements to know every platform.

Additional Information

Role Details

Company & Location: Attain Solutions | Remote within India; Bengaluru preferred

Contract and capacity : Planned 8-12 weeks, full time at approximately 35-40 hours per week

Initial assessment: Paid 1-2 weeks; subsequent build work depends on the selected approach and project approval

Experience and start : Typically 5-8 years in software engineering; relevant delivery evidence takes priority. Near-term availability preferred.

Proposed duration and milestones : 

We recommend planning an initial 8-12-week engagement from kickoff. The paid assessment comes first. The remaining phases proceed against an agreed scope, estimate and project approval; their timing depends on the chosen route, content readiness and access.

Phase 1: Technical assessment

Duration : 1-2 weeks

Expected outcome : Options and reuse assessment; architecture; integration risks; work estimate; operating-cost assumptions; recommendation.

Phase 2: Voice prototype

Duration : 2 weeks

Expected outcome : A hosted two-way practice example and sample assessment on approved or clearly marked demonstration content; documented limitations.

Phase 3: First pilot release

Duration: 4-6 weeks

Expected outcome: Agreed personal/commercial pair, learner access, usage controls, scoring, coaching PDF, structured results and required integration.

Phase 4 : Validation and handover

Duration : 1-2 weeks

Expected outcome: User testing, scoring calibration with content specialists, defect fixes, deployment and documented handover.

This is a staffing allowance, not a committed production release date. A focused extension of an existing platform may need less time; additional integration or product scope must be estimated separately.

What Successful Delivery Looks Like

- The AI sustains the approved customer role across different learner approaches, raises the required practice opportunity and keeps scenario facts consistent. 
- Representative strong, mixed and weak attempts are reviewed with the content specialists. Scores and feedback reflect demonstrated behaviour, with omissions and technical failures treated appropriately. 
- Agreed browsers and LMS launch paths work. Access boundaries, usage limits, retries and common audio failures have been tested with Attain QA. 
- Coaching PDFs match stored results. Actual audio measures are distinguished from text-derived estimates; optional speaking metrics are included only when agreed and validated. 
- Source code, scenario and rubric configuration, deployment instructions, monitoring, cost assumptions and a support runbook are handed over. 

Working arrangements and ongoing support

Provide a weekly demonstration, maintain an agreed task tracker and flag blockers early. Be available for scheduled US-time-zone discussions, with the overlap agreed in advance. Part-time support may continue for 3-6 months after the initial engagement, with scope and hours agreed separately; a starting planning allowance is 10-20 hours per month.

What To Include When Applying

Please share your CV or profile, earliest start date, weekly availability and expected hourly or monthly contract rate. Include a relevant voice-application demo or architecture walkthrough, your exact contribution, and one example of a difficult production issue you resolved. A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience is suitable.

Selection will focus on a technical discussion and a walkthrough of relevant work. The selected engineer will begin with the paid assessment described above. Training content and grading standards will be supplied and approved by the client specialists; Attain will coordinate scope and QA support.

Terms

- Standard work timing: 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST, to ensure sufficient overlap with Tango Analytics' US-based teams and clients. 
- Flexibility may be required during critical project milestones, deployment activities, go-live events, and production support periods. 
- Location: Remote. Overlap with US morning and/or evening hours required.

We are seeking a Lead Frontend Engineer to be the technical anchor for our frontend capability. This role goes beyond feature delivery; you will define the frontend architecture, establish the component design system, own the Next.js application structure, drive performance standards, and mentor senior and mid-level frontend engineers. You will build the most complex, data-intensive UI surfaces: real-time attribution dashboards, AI-powered campaign builders, and platform-embedded intelligence widgets, all in a React + Next.js stack integrated with Elasticsearch-powered search and streaming AI responses.

Responsibilities:

- Own and evolve the frontend architecture: Next.js App Router structure, component boundaries, state management strategy (Redux), and data-fetching patterns applying hexagonal UI principles where the component layer is decoupled from specific backend service contracts.
- Design and build the most technically complex UI surfaces: real-time attribution dashboards (streaming data), AI-powered campaign builder (LLM response streaming), Elasticsearch-backed customer search with faceted filtering, and platform-embedded opportunity cards.
- Define the component design system: Atomic component library, theming contracts, accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1), and Storybook-based documentation.
- Establish frontend performance standards: Core Web Vitals targets, bundle size budgets, SSR/SSG strategy with Next.js, lazy loading, and virtualisation for large data tables.
- Lead Next.js architecture decisions: App Router vs. Pages Router tradeoffs, RSC (React Server Components) applicability, streaming SSR for AI-generated content, and API route design.
- Integrate AI-native frontend patterns: streaming LLM responses into UI components, real-time score updates from Redis/Aerospike via SSE, and Elasticsearch typeahead search.
- Drive code quality through design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and frontend-specific engineering standards.
- Mentor senior and mid-level frontend engineers, setting the bar for component design, test coverage, and performance discipline.
- Collaborate closely with backend staff engineers to define API contracts and with designers to implement pixel-perfect, accessible UIs.

Requirements:

- 8+ years of frontend engineering experience with deep React and Next.js expertise in production systems.
- Mastery of Next.js 14+ App Router, React Server Components, streaming SSR, and static generation, knowing when to apply each pattern.
- Strong TypeScript expertise: type safety across component props, API contracts, Redux store shape, and server/client boundaries.
- Deep Redux expertise: slice design, selector optimisation, middleware patterns, and RTK Query for data fetching.
- Proven experience building data-intensive dashboards with real-time data (WebSocket, SSE, or polling) and chart libraries (Recharts, D3.js ).
- Experience integrating Elasticsearch-powered search UIs: typeahead, faceted search, and result ranking display.
- Strong frontend performance engineering: bundle analysis, code splitting, memoisation, virtualisation, and Core Web Vitals optimisation.
- Experience in establishing and maintaining component design systems with accessibility standards.
- Must have proven experience leading front-end development teams, mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions to deliver high-quality solutions.
- Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across a frontend team.

Good to Have:

- Experience streaming LLM/AI-generated content into React UI components (token streaming, partial rendering patterns).
- Familiarity with platform-embedded micro-frontend patterns (module federation or iframe-based embedding).
- Background in automotive retail, eCommerce analytics, or SaaS BI/reporting platforms.
- Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual regression testing.

title: Software Engineer I - FullStack
description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Team

The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling’s "Enterprise Studio" experience.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer I (Full Stack) on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences.

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

What You Will Do

- Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases. 
- Contribute to systems that operate at scale, with exposure to distributed systems challenges and technologies such as Kafka, Flink, and AWS. 
- While your strength lies in backend engineering, you will also contribute to the frontend codebase. You will write high-quality React and React Native code to ship end-to-end features and help deliver intuitive, performant UI components. 
- Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions. 
- Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, participate in thoughtful code reviews, and contribute to strong engineering standards across backend and frontend systems. 
- Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them. 

What You Will Need

- 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
- Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred. 
- Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own. 
- Ability to design scalable, reliable systems and reason through trade-offs such as consistency, performance, and fault tolerance. 
- Experience building reusable systems, frameworks, or developer-facing components is a plus. You should be excited by building flexible foundations that can support multiple product use cases over time. 
- A track record of independently driving projects, navigating ambiguity, and delivering high-quality outcomes. 
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

- Design and develop full-stack solutions for Post Add to Cart and Cart services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi-tiered distributed systems
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
- Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data-driven analysis and experimentation
- Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement

A day in the life

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long-term health.

About The Team

We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Store fulfillment volume is expected to roughly double by 2030, and the team is actively simplifying and consolidating services, adopting multi-tenancy, improving resiliency (circuit breakers, timeouts, rate limiting, canary rollouts, failover automation) and enabling next-generation store capacity solutions such as automation and dense storage.

- Lead architecture and design reviews; drive service simplification, multi-tenancy, multi-region resiliency and disaster-recovery capabilities.

- 5+ years of experience building microservices in Java (Spring/Spring Boot); exceptional Go engineers with equivalent distributed-systems depth who can work in Java may also be considered.
- Strong computer science fundamentals – data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking and problem solving.
- Deep distributed-systems expertise: microservices, event-driven design, consistency, idempotency, partitioning, retries/timeouts, backpressure, fault isolation and failure recovery.

- Hands-on experience with messaging and data platforms – Kafka plus SQL/NoSQL stores (e.g., Cosmos DB, Cassandra, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle); ability to reason about scale, schema evolution and data access patterns.
- Cloud-native engineering: Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing and observability, with strong ownership of production readiness and reliability.
- Excellent production troubleshooting skills: logs, metrics, traces, thread dumps/profiling, incident mitigation and root-cause analysis.
- Practical, advanced use of AI/GenAI tools in day-to-day engineering, with disciplined validation of the output.

description:

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world.

Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture.

Within Azure Data, the big data analytics team provides a range of products that enable data engineers and data scientists to extract intelligence from all data – structured, semi-structured, and unstructured. We build the Data Engineering, Data Science, and Data Integration pillars of Microsoft Fabric.

Our team is part of Azure Data, building reliable, large-scale distributed systems for data engineering. We develop Fabric Materialized Lake Views, which automatically refresh analytical data in Microsoft Fabric so customers can query up-to-date results without manual pipelines. We also maintain Azure HDInsight in production, the PaaS platform running open-source Hadoop, Spark, HBase, and Kafka. You will get hands-on experience with both.

As a Software Engineer II, you will design and ship features for our Fabric-based SaaS platform with minimal supervision. You will write high-quality code, debug complex distributed systems, and work closely with Spark and Spark-based extension frameworks. You will own features through the full lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, deployment, and production support. You will also maintain HDInsight components in production. This role will deepen your expertise in distributed systems, cloud platform engineering, and large-scale data infrastructure.

Successful candidates will have strong experience in one or more of these areas: designing and coding cloud-scale SaaS products; building data lakes or data engineering tools; working with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or HBase; enterprise software development in C#, Scala, Java, or Python; and working with the Azure stack (Storage, Compute, Networking, Fabric, Purview, Synapse, AKS, DevOps, Data Factory, Power BI).

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.

Responsibilities

Write extensible, maintainable code in C#, Java, Scala, or Python for Fabric Materialized Lake View services and HDInsight components. Use AI tools and coding best practices across the development lifecycle. Produce code with few defects and clear test coverage.

- Design data refresh, scheduling, and query optimisation features with minimal supervision. Evaluate design options, document trade-offs, and begin owning or co-owning the architecture of Fabric data engineering components.
- Review code from teammates for correctness, test coverage, security risks, and adherence to team standards. Coach engineers through code reviews and provide feedback that raises code quality across the team.
- Debug complex issues in distributed systems running on Azure, Linux, and Windows. Use debugging tools, logs, and telemetry to verify assumptions before issues reach production. Conduct incident retrospectives for Fabric and HDInsight services; identify root causes, implement repairs, and prevent recurrence.
- Run live site operations on a rotational, on-call basis. Diagnose and fix both simple and complex issues across Fabric and HDInsight workloads. Improve troubleshooting guides, tests, and telemetry to make on-call better for the team.
- Integrate logging and instrumentation to gather telemetry on system health, performance, reliability, and security. Classify metrics, build dashboards, and create alerts that surface problems across the Materialized Lake View pipeline.
- Work with product managers, technical leads, and partners across geographies to define customer requirements for Materialized Lake View features. Incorporate customer feedback into designs. Understand and advocate for the security and privacy needs of customers.

Embody our culture and values

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, Apache Spark, Kafka, Spark SQL, PySpark, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python; OR equivalent experience.

- This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Engineering Leader
description:
About Whatfix
Whatfix is an AI platform that makes enterprise software, and now enterprise AI, usable for the people who depend on it. We call this userization: technology should adapt to the user, not the other way round.
Our proprietary AI engine, ScreenSense, reads what a user is doing inside an application and the intent behind it. It then delivers guidance, knowledge and automation in the flow of work. ScreenSense powers Digital Adoption, Product Analytics and Mirror, with Whatfix AI Agents built into each. Our newer AI-first products include Seek, an AI-native assistant that understands business context and acts across applications, and Mirror 2.0, which pairs system and role simulation with assessment.
- 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ of the Fortune 500
- ~$270M raised, including a $125M Series E led by Warburg Pincus with SoftBank Vision Fund 2
- Named a Leader in Digital Adoption Platforms by Gartner, Forrester, IDC and Everest Group, and a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP in 2024 and 2025
- Seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore and Australia

The role
This is a leadership role for someone who still builds.
Engineering at Whatfix has changed how it works. Every engineer takes a problem from spec to production, with coding agents doing much of the implementation. People own the judgment: what to build, how it should work, and whether what the agent produced is actually right.
As an Engineering Leader (EL3), you own engineering for a product or platform area end to end. You lead a team of around 7-12 or more engineers and shape the human + agent system they work in. You stay close enough to the code to make, and challenge, the important technical calls. And you still ship.

What you'll own
- Your area, end to end. Delivery, architecture, reliability, production health, and infrastructure and AI cost for a product or platform area.
- The technical bar. Important design decisions in your area come from you or go through you. You take architecture choices to our Architecture Review Board (ARB) and guide other teams that touch your code.
- Production quality. Work goes live with a spec, automated tests, monitoring and runbooks. Production issues get root-cause fixes and systemic improvements, not patches.
- Customer impact. You stay on top of customer issues, keep customers unblocked, and make sure Presales, Solutions and Support can confidently represent what your area does.
- The roadmap, with Product. You bring a clear technical and customer point of view, plan sprints, run spikes to retire risk early, and balance new work against tech debt and stability.

How your team builds
You don't just encourage AI adoption. You build the system that makes delegating to agents reliable.
- Spec-first by default. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria.
- The right context and guardrails. Repository context and instruction files, shared specs and prompts, tooling and review workflows that let engineers hand substantial work to coding agents with confidence.
- A Definition of Done that holds up with agents in the loop. Spec in the repo, tests before delegation, human review of agent-generated code, context files kept current.
- Engineers who verify, not just generate. You coach the team to write executable specs, delegate well, and critically review what comes back. Nothing ships because it compiles or passes its own generated tests.
- Clear accountability. Every engineer owns what they merge, whether a person or an agent wrote it.
- Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact.

You still build
We mean this literally. With coding agents, there's no longer a trade-off between leading a team and shipping product.
- You take real problems from spec to production, using coding agents.
- You review specs, designs and agent-generated code closely enough to catch the race condition, the missing index or the weak assumption.
- You debug production issues hands-on and can explain, change and fix any system your team owns.
- You prototype and run spikes on the hardest technical questions before the team commits to an approach.

Leading the team
- Manage around 7-12 engineers directly, and over time possibly a further team through another Engineering Leader.
- Own performance end to end: expectations, ongoing feedback, reviews, compensation inputs, promotions, and managing underperformance, with support from HR.
- Give clear, direct feedback all the time, not just at review time.
- Build a team that can run several large initiatives in parallel, without you as the bottleneck and with no single points of failure.
- Hire for Engineering, not just your team. Raise the bar in interviews and help close strong senior talent.
- Build a culture of trust and ownership, where good work gets recognized publicly and in real time.

What success looks like
- First 90 days: You know your area's architecture, production health and cost. You've shipped real work yourself through the team's agent workflow. Every engineer knows exactly what you expect from them.
- By 6 months: Specs, the Definition of Done and agent guardrails are followed consistently, not just on paper. Customer issues are under control. Product and customer-facing teams come to you first for your area.
- By 12 months: Your team owns several large features at once without leaning on you. You can show measurable gains in cycle time, rework or escaped defects that come from better specs and delegation, not longer hours. At least one engineer has grown into a bigger scope.

What you bring
- Usually 8-15 years in software engineering, including time managing engineers directly. What you've owned matters more to us than the number.
- Strong engineering judgment in system design and distributed systems, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and high availability.
- Full-stack fluency. Our services are mostly Java and Spring Boot, our frontends TypeScript and React, running on Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD with relational and NoSQL stores. We don't hire by stack boundary. You work across it.
- Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result.
- A track record of leading teams that ship production-quality software, and of growing engineers who now own complex systems.
- Customer-first thinking. You tie technical decisions to business outcomes.
- Clear, structured communication. You can explain a hard trade-off to an engineer, a product manager or a customer.
- Good to have: experience building AI features into products, such as LLM integration, retrieval, agents or evaluation harnesses.

This may not be the right role if
- Your current role is mostly reviews, planning and people management, and you don't miss building.
- You see coding agents as a productivity add-on rather than a change in how engineering gets done.
- You'd rather own one layer of the stack than a whole problem.

How we'll assess you
Our interviews look like the job. You'll use a coding agent of your choice wherever it fits.
- Discovery conversation with a peer or our Head of Engineering
- Problem solving with a coding agent: build something that works, adapt it when a new constraint lands, explain what the agent produced, and review AI-generated code critically.
- System design and review: work through a larger problem end to end, then critique an existing design or code.
- Leadership conversation: how you've built and run teams, including a real example of meaningful work you handed to an agent, the context you gave it, and what you caught in review.

Working at Whatfix
How we work. We believe being together in the office 4-5 days a week makes communication easier, builds community and speeds up innovation.
Benefits (India). Best-in-class medical insurance, lunch and dinner buffet, doorstep cab drop, education sponsorship, internal and global mobility programs, and the chance to represent Whatfix at global events.
Our values. Customer First · Empathy · Transparency · Fail Fast and Scale Fast · No Hierarchies for Communication · Deep Dive and Innovate · Trust, Do It as You Own It.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of, not in spite of, their differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.
