title: AI Engineering Lead
description:
Role Overview:
We are looking for an AI-first Engineering Lead to build and run a high-output engineering team. The team is responsible for customized client development, independent technology projects and workflow automation.
This is not a conventional engineering management role where AI is used only as a productivity tool. The entire mandate is built around an AI-native engineering model.
AI agents, coding copilots, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, debugging and workflow automation should become the default way the team operates.
You will lead a team of approximately 7–10 engineers and QA resources and deliver approximately 3–5 new customized projects or programs every month, while also supporting existing enterprise applications.
The core objective is:
Use AI to materially increase engineering output, reduce repetitive manual work and create a predictable, high-quality customization and project-delivery engine.

Business Context:
We build and operate enterprise Loyalty, Promotions, Rewards and Engagement platforms for large brands. Our core platform supports common functionality, but enterprise clients regularly require:
- Additional workflows
- Client-specific business logic
- Integrations
- New modules
- Custom interfaces
- Special reporting
- Independent applications
- New digital experiences
- Functionality not yet available in the standard platform
The Engineering Lead will own the engineering function responsible for delivering these requirements. The role will also take over a substantial part of the technology responsibility that currently depends on individual knowledge holders.

AI-First Engineering Mandate:
The most important part of this role is the ability to redesign how engineering work gets done. We want the development lifecycle to increasingly operate through the following flow:
Requirement → AI-assisted analysis → Solution design → Agentic development → Automated testing → AI-assisted review → Deployment → Monitoring → AI-assisted support
The Engineering Lead will create workflows where AI handles as much repeatable engineering work as safely possible. This includes:
- Legacy code understanding
- Codebase navigation
- Dependency mapping
- Impact analysis
- Code generation
- Repetitive customization development
- API scaffolding
- Refactoring
- Migration scripts
- Automated test generation
- Regression automation
- Code review
- Documentation
- Security analysis
- Debugging
- Incident diagnosis
- Production support assistance
Tools may include:
- Cursor
- Claude
- Copilot
- AI coding agents
- Workflow automation tools
- LLM-based internal engineering agents
- Automated testing and review systems
The ideal candidate should be able to move beyond simple “AI-assisted coding” into AI-orchestrated engineering workflows.

Workflow Automation:
You will identify repetitive engineering and operational workflows that can be automated. Examples include:
- Requirement interpretation
- Technical estimation
- Test case preparation
- Release readiness checks
- Deployment validation
- Log analysis
- Incident triage
- Documentation updates
- Change impact analysis
- Support diagnostics
- Repetitive client customization work
AI and automation should progressively reduce the manual effort required across the full software delivery lifecycle.

Customized Client Development:
The team will own all engineering requirements that fall outside the standard capabilities of the core platform. For every requirement, the Engineering Lead must decide whether it should be:
- Handled through configuration
- Developed once as a reusable platform capability
- Built as a controlled customization
- Delivered as a separate, independent application

The Engineering Lead will own:
- Requirement understanding
- Technical solutioning
- Architecture
- Estimation
- Sprint planning
- Resource allocation
- Development
- Code review
- QA
- Deployment
- Production stabilization
Multiple client projects will run in parallel.

Independent Projects:
The team will also deliver technology projects that may sit outside the existing core platform. These may include:
- Client portals
- Workflow applications
- Microsites
- API integrations
- Dashboards
- Campaign technologies
- Automation tools
- Internal productivity systems
- Experimental products
The Engineering Lead should be comfortable choosing the right architecture and stack instead of forcing every requirement into the existing monolith.

Current Technology Environment:
The current platform includes:
- PHP / Yii
- Angular
- Ionic / mobile components
- PostgreSQL
- APIs and third-party integrations
- Queue and asynchronous processing
- Enterprise client applications
- A largely monolithic architecture
- Multiple historic client-specific customizations
The environment is being modernized progressively. The person joining must be comfortable working with an existing monolith, improving it pragmatically, and using AI to understand and extend it efficiently. This is not a greenfield-only role.

Team Leadership:
The Engineering Lead will manage approximately 7–10 engineers, QA and technical resources and will be expected to actively drive:
- Engineering productivity
- Sprint planning
- Resource allocation
- Delivery commitments
- Technical reviews
- Architecture
- Code quality
- QA quality
- Production readiness
- AI adoption
- Workflow automation
- Individual accountability
The person must stay close enough to the work to know:
- What each engineer is building
- Where delivery is blocked
- Where AI can replace repetitive work
- Where quality is weak
- Where architectural decisions need intervention

Engineering Quality & Architecture:
The Engineering Lead will be accountable for:
- Architecture decisions
- Reusable components
- API design
- Database design
- Security
- Scalability
- Performance
- Code standards
- Technical debt
- CI/CD
- Production reliability
The person must ensure that short-term custom requirements do not create long-term fragmentation. A key principle is:
Build once where possible, configure repeatedly, customize only where necessary.

Quality & Delivery Discipline:
You will establish a disciplined delivery model covering:
- Scope clarity
- Estimation
- Sprint execution
- Code review
- Automated testing
- Regression
- QA gates
- Release checklists
- Deployment
- Rollback
- Incident management
- Root cause analysis (RCA)
- Production monitoring

What We Are Looking For:
We are specifically looking for someone who:
- Thinks AI-first rather than traditional-development-first
- Has strong hands-on engineering depth
- Can manage a team of 7–10 people
- Can architect and review systems
- Is highly comfortable with legacy and monolithic applications
- Can run multiple client projects simultaneously
- Understands AI coding tools deeply
- Can design agentic engineering workflows
- Can automate repetitive development and support processes
- Can balance speed, quality and business deadlines
- Is strong in debugging and production problem-solving
- Can challenge weak engineering practices
- Can improve engineering output per person

Relevant Experience:
Ideally, the candidate will have:
- 10–15+ years of software engineering experience
- 3–5+ years in engineering leadership
- Experience managing teams of 7–15 people
- Strong backend and API architecture skills
- Experience in PHP / Yii / Laravel or similar frameworks (preferred)
- Angular or modern frontend exposure
- PostgreSQL or other relational database experience
- CI/CD and production engineering experience
- Enterprise integration experience
- Legacy modernization experience
- Strong hands-on use of Cursor, Claude, Copilot or equivalent tools
- Experience building AI-assisted or agentic development workflows

title: Analyst - Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Artha Group**

Artha Group is a performance-first investment house managing 2,300 crores across domestic and international investment vehicles, including Category I II AIFs, LLPs, and Private Limited companies. With active investments in 130+ startups, with 32+ successful exits, and 10+ renewable energy projects. We operate at the convergence of capital precision and operational depth.

**Role Overview**

Artha Group is seeking an Analyst - Full Stack Engineer to join its internal Tech team as a full-time hire. You will build and ship the web applications, internal tools and workflow automations that the firm s teams run on, working primarily in Next.js, with clean code and a systems mindset rather than one-off fixes.

This is a hands-on engineering role with an analyst s instinct. You will understand how a process actually works before you automate it, and you will design for the people who use it. Our users come from many different backgrounds, so what you build has to be intuitive, accessible and clear to people with very different levels of technical comfort. You will own what you ship through to adoption and improvement. We welcome engineers at the start of their careers as well as those with a few years of experience. What matters is the quality of what you have built and how you think, not only the number of years behind you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Application Development**

* Experience in building Conversational Video/Audio Platforms
* Write clean, readable, well-tested code that other engineers can maintain and extend.
* Own what you build through release, monitoring and ongoing improvement.

**User-Centred Design and Adoption**

* Design interfaces and flows for audiences from multiple and diverse backgrounds, ensuring tools are intuitive, accessible and usable without training.
* Apply a consumer-grade standard of usability to internal products, so adoption comes from the experience and not from mandates.
* Gather feedback from real users, observe how they actually use what you build, and turn it into prioritised improvements.

**Internal Tooling and Workflow Automation**

* Build internal tools and automations that replace manual, repetitive and spreadsheet-driven processes across teams.
* Develop pipeline and tracking systems that give teams reliable visibility into their work.
* Integrate internal tools with existing systems and data sources, so information flows without re-entry.

**Systems Thinking and Code Quality**

* Think in systems: model data, workflows and integrations deliberately, and weigh trade-offs between speed, maintainability and scale.
* Make sound design decisions for tools that must be both robust and easy for non-technical users.
* Refactor and improve existing systems proactively rather than letting technical debt accumulate.

**Requirements Analysis and Stakeholder Partnership**

* Work directly with internal teams to understand their processes, pain points and goals, and translate them into clear technical solutions.
* Define requirements and success measures before building, and validate outcomes after release.

**Documentation and Reliability**

* Maintain clear documentation for the systems, tools and workflows you build.
* Handle confidential financial, portfolio and people data with discretion, and build tools with access controls, permissions and data protection designed in from the start.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 0 to 4 years of hands-on engineering experience, through professional roles, internships or substantial personal and open-source projects, with a track record of building and shipping real applications.
* Hands-on experience with Next.js and React, with strong fundamentals in JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Strong fundamentals in writing clean, maintainable code, and the ability to think in systems.
* Experience building D2C or consumer-facing products is valued, as we hold our internal tools to the same standard of intuitive, self-explanatory design.
* Ability to translate loosely defined business needs into well-scoped technical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work comfortably with non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in internal tooling, workflow automation or product-adjacent engineering is preferred, as is experience building mobile applications.
* A background in HR tech, ATS platforms or applicant tracking pipelines is a meaningful differentiator, as a part of the roadmap includes the systems that support our hiring, talent and people workflows.

**Compensation**

* Total Annual Package: 12,00,000 (12 LPA)
* Fixed Annual Salary: 10,00,000
* Annual Retention Bonus: 2,00,000, paid at the end of each year

title: Full Stack Engineer (Go and React)
description:
Job Description

Join a team building innovative, cloud-native applications that power next-generation conversational AI and enterprise solutions. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will develop scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and modern web applications using Golang and React. You will work with modern cloud technologies, solve complex engineering challenges, and contribute to reliable, high-performance solutions that support evolving business needs.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Golang.
* Build responsive, reusable, and user-friendly web applications using React, and modern frontend development practices.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services, third-party APIs, and enterprise systems to enable seamless data exchange and business workflows.
* Develop and enhance cloud-native applications and distributed systems, contributing to reliable, scalable, and efficient application architectures.
* Write clean, maintainable, and testable code; participate in code reviews, automated testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Support CI/CD pipelines, application deployments, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting to maintain application stability and reliability.
* Identify and resolve technical issues, optimize application performance, and contribute to continuous improvements across the development lifecycle.
* Work closely with product, architecture, security, and engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, using approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve productivity and code quality. Qualifications

* 5+ years of professional software development experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing frontend applications using React.
* 3+ years of experience in Go programming, backend development, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure.
* Hands-on experience with distributed systems, API integrations, and application design.
* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Understanding of application security, performance optimization, debugging, and production support.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice To Have**

* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Kafka.
* Exposure to conversational AI, chatbot applications, or AI-powered solutions.
* Familiarity with real-time communication, voice integrations, or telephony technologies.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
* Exposure to third-party AI/ML integrations or generative AI solutions.
